taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a shrub (FEIS, Anderson 2001).

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata (Condalia lycioides var. canescens, Ziziphus obtusifolia var. canescens): "Shrubs or small trees, 1–3(–4) m".

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata: "Shrubs or small trees, 1–3(–4) m"; Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 555): up to 2.5 m.

traits.life_span.note: FEIS species review, Ziziphus obtusifolia (Sullivan 1993), the species of which this is the Arizona variety canescens: "a native, deciduous medium-sized shrub".

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: a much-branched shrub.

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS species review, Ziziphus obtusifolia (Sullivan 1993), the species of which this is the Arizona variety canescens: "a native, deciduous medium-sized shrub".

traits.rosette.note: FEIS species review, Ziziphus obtusifolia (Sullivan 1993), the species of which this is the Arizona variety canescens: "densely branched and leafy": no rosette.

traits.spines.note: FEIS species review, Ziziphus obtusifolia (Sullivan 1993), the species of which this is the Arizona variety canescens: "The branches are light gray, covered with a waxy bloom, and have thorn-tipped branchlets".

traits.bark_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: bark pale grey-green, the branches canescent; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves alternate or fascicled on short spurs, as in the genus.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: leaves oblong: simple.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: leaves entire or denticulate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata: blade "ovate, oblong, or elliptic to nearly linear, 0.3–2(–2.5) cm, relatively thin-herbaceous".

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 554), Condalia lycioides: leaves 5 mm or more wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: leaves oblong.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: leaves entire or denticulate.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: canescent: finely grey-hairy.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: flowers in short-peduncled umbels.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata: "Inflorescences pedunculate thyrses, 10–20 mm, (5–)10–30-flowered, peduncles 2–4 mm".

traits.flower_colour.note: Flowers small, yellow-green; sRGB by eye, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 265950085, 6650299, 212685543, 20034541, 107526343, 77775055, 63359014, 168755382): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 554), Condalia lycioides: petals present; five, as in the family's flowers in the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS species review, Ziziphus obtusifolia (Sullivan 1993), the species of which this is the Arizona variety canescens: "The fruit is a drupe with one stone".

traits.fruit_shape.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 554), Condalia lycioides: drupe globose (Abrams 1951 p. 61: ellipsoid).

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata: "Drupes dark blue to blue-black or purplish, globose to slightly elongate, 7–10 mm".

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 554), Condalia lycioides: drupe dark blue with a bloom; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (eFloras, read 2026-10-19), Ziziphus divaricata: "Flowering Apr–Jul(–Sep)".

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: drupes ripen from July to September.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 555), Condalia lycioides var. canescens: 5,000 feet or lower: about 1,520 m.

traits.light.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a shrub of open desert scrub, in full sun.

traits.moisture.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 61, Condalia lycioides var. canescens: usually in bottom lands: dry, but where runoff gathers.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a rigid, densely and divaricately branched shrub of pale grey-green, thorn-tipped branchlets, small grey-green leaves, and dark blue berries with a bloom. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

generator.params.note: Set by hand for graythorn from its sources and the photos the traits cite, on the template of snowbrush ceanothus (ceanothus-velutinus); the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 2 m tall at 15 years in the open, the middle of FNA's 1-3 m (an earlier 1.5 m guessed a drier bajada plant, which the open setting does not model). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada, Tucson Mountain District, 2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles (1942) and Abrams, counts and colours from iNaturalist photos, drawing values from the library's rules for the form.
